# Migrated to VWJF/rcg-sites

These workflow/action copies are **disabled** (GitHub Actions only loads `.github/workflows/*.yml` at the workflows root, not subfolders).

Active implementations live in [`VWJF/rcg-sites`](https://github.com/VWJF/rcg-sites) on branch `refactor-from-cs` (until tagged releases). Coastal entrypoints under `.github/workflows/` call that branch.

Do not rely on these files remaining in sync; update `rcg-sites` instead.
